a.xlink:title: Makes the widgets, empty until a loaded document is set.
Appends a composition without units, with a new unique id, and selects it.
Shows the current state of the document.
Asks for a rolling stock unit of the scene and appends it to the units of the selected composition.
Takes the id from the field. An empty or used id is dropped and the field shows the old id again.
Deletes the selected composition after the user has confirmed it; refused while a service uses it.
Inserts a copy of the selected composition, with a new unique id, after it.
Moves the selected unit one place towards the back of the composition.
Moves the selected unit one place towards the front of the composition.
Asks for the plot of the selected unit, which has to have a traction curve.
Shows the sources and the warning of the selected unit again, for example after its sources have chan...
Removes the selected unit from the selected composition.
A panel without a document.
The panel has changed the document. Emitted after SceneDocument::changed().
True when a scene is loaded.
A free composition id.
A message that the user acknowledges. A scripted run has no user to do that, so nothing is shown then...
A Yes or No question whose default answer is No; true for Yes. It asks also in a suppressed run.
A chainage in kilometres as printf "%f" writes it, the form used in switch section ids.
An empty list.
Number of sections.
The parts of reference between its '/', in order, empty parts included.
The train unit with this id, or null. The pointer points into the model.
The plot of the traction curve of this train unit is wanted.
Shows the units again when the rolling stock changes, with the same unit selected.
Takes the text of a field that is being edited into the document, as if the user had left the field.
